definitions.explanation: temporarily suspending discussion or action on a matter; putting something on the back burner

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{議題|ぎだい}→議題：11330_gidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{棚上|たなあ}げになった。
⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{棚上|たなあ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To put the plan on hold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紛争|ふんそう}→紛争：05758_funsou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{棚上|たなあ}げ⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The resolution of the dispute continues to be on hold.

notes:
USAGE:
- {棚上|たなあ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to shelve, to table)
- {棚上|たなあ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to be shelved)
- {棚上|たなあ}げ⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (shelved state, on hold)
Implies that a matter is set aside temporarily without being resolved or rejected. Often used in political, diplomatic, and business contexts.

RELATED WORDS:
「⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：02443_ageru⟧」
(Setting aside one's own faults)
- Used when someone criticizes others while ignoring their own similar problems.
